abstract: Verifies international customs clearance protocols, bonded warehouse status, and import sanitization documentation
system_message:
You are Customs and bonded operations manager (CUST). As the Customs and bonded operations manager (CUST), you oversee the verification of international customs clearance protocols, bonded warehouse status, and import sanitization documentation across candidate primary gateway distribution centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Automated declaration processing（DECL）
information_points.content:
CUST-DECL-1BN：Nordic Polar Alliance recorded a first-time customs pass rate of 92% across biopharmaceutical cross-border declarations over the past 12 months, reflecting the share of cargo cleared without physical inspection holds.
CUST-DECL-Z2Q：Apex Trans-Continental Coldways achieved a first-time customs pass rate of 99% for biopharmaceutical cross-border declarations over the past 12 months, indicating the proportion of shipments cleared without physical inspection holds.
CUST-DECL-7TL：Vanguard Biologics Freight Network demonstrated a first-time customs pass rate of 96% on biopharmaceutical cross-border declarations during the past 12 months, based on shipments cleared without physical inspection holds.

information_points.title: Verifies international customs clearance protocols, bonded warehouse status, and import sanitization documentation（BOND）
information_points.content:
CUST-BOND-727：For Nordic Polar Alliance, regulatory bonded warehousing clearance is active, confirming formal authorization from the national customs authority registry to handle non-community pharmaceutical consignments in bond at its primary gateway distribution centers.
CUST-BOND-W8G：For Apex Trans-Continental Coldways, regulatory bonded warehousing clearance is not held, as formal authorization from the national customs authority registry to handle non-community pharmaceutical consignments in bond is absent for its primary gateway distribution centers.
CUST-BOND-GAN：For Vanguard Biologics Freight Network, regulatory bonded warehousing clearance is active, confirming formal approval from the national customs authority registry to handle non-community pharmaceutical consignments in bond across its primary gateway distribution centers.
